Linear programming. Let's find corner points.

3 n_A + 2 n_B = 10
3 n_A + 4 n_B = 40/3 ≈ 13.3333

Subtract first from second: (3 n_A cancels) 2 n_B = 40/3 - 10 = (40 - 30)/3 = 10/3 => n_B = (10/3)/2 = 10/6 = 5/3 ≈ 1.6667.

Plug into first: 3 n_A + 2*(5/3) = 10 => 3 n_A + 10/3 = 10 => 3 n_A = 10 - 10/3 = (30 -10)/3 = 20/3 => n_A = (20/3)/3 = 20/9 ≈ 2.2222.

Compute Q = 540 n_A + 600 n_B = 540*(20/9) + 600*(5/3) = (540*20)/9 + (600*5)/3.

540/9 = 60, so 60*20 = 1200. Next, 600/3 = 200, *5 = 1000. Total Q = 2200 kJ.

Check constraints: time = 60*20/9 + 40*5/3 = (1200/9) + (200/3) = 133.33 + 66.67 = 200 s exactly. Energy = 180*20/9 + 240*5/3 = (3600/9) + (1200/3) = 400 + 400 = 800 kJ exactly. So Q_max = 2200 kJ.

3 n_A + 4 n_B = 10
